page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg6.26xlarge is a bare-metal instance belonging to the ECS Bare Metal family, built on the x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz across 104 virtual processing cores. It provides 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.69 GB per core. The platform operates through a KVM hypervisor environment and does not include hardware GPU acceleration.

For I/O and connectivity, the ecs.ebmg6.26xlarge delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The instance does not bundle local disk storage, requiring all persistent storage and operating system volumes to be provisioned via network-attached storage. This separation means storage throughput and latency depend directly on the chosen network storage configuration.

With a memory-to-vCPU ratio approaching 1:4 and a substantial allocation of 104 dedicated execution threads, this server targets high-density workloads that benefit from dedicated hardware without local drive overhead. Suitable deployment scenarios include enterprise resource planning software, large-scale container clusters, database engines backed by network storage, and compute-intensive batch processing.
